items.title: Vladimir Putin, a president sealed off in a Russia under lockdown
items.description: 'The Putin System' (1/3). The many 'siloviki,' officers drawn from Russia's security services, have seized power and are now omnipresent among the country's elites. Within society, they have spread an atmosphere of fear and suspicion that prohibits any questioning of the Kremlin or its war in Ukraine.

items.title: EU leaders urge unity after Russian strike on train
items.description: Russia's drone attack on a train near the Ukraine-Poland border has triggered EU calls to up support for Kyiv. Allies of Ukraine should show they "are not scared," said the bloc's top diplomat, Kaja Kallas.

items.title: Six UN staff killed in Gaza school strike; Lebanon violations mount
items.description: Israeli strikes killed six UN workers and civilians at a school sheltering displaced families in Gaza as needs grow, according to the UN agency for Palestine refugees, UNRWA.

items.title: Watch: Why a Russian strike on train near Ukraine-Poland border could mark an escalation

items.title: Russian Military Slang Reveals the Reality of Life on the Front Line
items.description: A 250-page study of almost 7,000 communications between Russian military personnel and their relatives in 2025 illustrated the reality of life in the combat zone for those fed into the “meat grinder” that is Putin’s “special military operation.”
